findings.body: Forge's generated Node test command receives no suggestion. src/forge/init.py:59 and :120 use `[ ! -f package.json ] || (npm ci && npm test)`; the v1.2.2 fixture uses the same command. Splitting it here leaves `npm test)` as the final part, so neither a Vitest nor Jest package script is recognized. Both doctor and upgrade consequently print no fast_test line for these new and previously adopted clients. The new tests miss this because tests/test_quick_test_suggestions.py:56–58 replaces the generated test command before checking advice. Support Forge's generated wrapper and cover it through the command entry points.

findings.body: For `uv run pytest && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test`, with a Vitest or Jest test script, the Python picker removes npm ci and npm test but retains npm run lint. The recommendation starts with this picker, so on a clean checkout lint executes before dependencies are installed and the command fails before reaching the recommended npm ci. On an installed checkout, lint runs twice. This is additional evidence beyond the isolation ruling: non-test Node checks remain dependent on the installation being removed. Preserve their setup and execute retained checks once when composing the mixed recommendation.
findings.title: Keep installation before retained Node checks in mixed commands

findings.body: The separator repair breaks invocations that already supply npm options. For example, `npm exec --package=vitest vitest run` becomes `npm exec -- --package=vitest vitest run --changed {base} --passWithNoTests`. npm now treats --package=vitest as positional command input, so the runner cannot launch. Jest and workspace options have the same problem through both suggestion callers. This extends the previous npm finding with an option-bearing invocation the repair does not cover. Keep npm options before the separator and insert it immediately before the runner, as required by the [npm exec contract](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-exec/).
findings.title: Insert npm exec's separator after its existing options

why: Repos without a quick test setting don't learn which quick test command fits them
